limitations: Ethereum RLUSD metadata/proxy and USDC qualified control read observations added on 2026-10-20; no public-network transactions. Other reports retain original times.
Official address references, historical observations and private fixture results are separate evidence axes.
Research entries do not register adapters, verify issuers, change prior verdicts or prove reserves/redemption/peg stability.
Solana mint account owner/program and XRPL ledger/currency-issuer state remain unobserved.
